name: herdr-vscode-sync
description: Follow the focused Herdr workspace (TUI or desktop app) in a VS Code window.

commands.title: Herdr VS Code Sync: follow now

herdrVscodeSync.currentFile.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `current.json` that Herdr writes. When empty, the extension uses the shared state file (`~/.local/state/herdr-vscode-sync/current.json` on Linux) and falls back to the old Herdr plugin data directories (`~/.config/herdr` / `~/.local/state/herdr`).

herdrVscodeSync.appBin.markdownDescription: Absolute path to `herdr-app`. When empty: `$HERDR_APP_BIN`, then `PATH`, then `~/.local/bin` and `~/.local/share/herdr-app`.

herdrVscodeSync.hcBin.markdownDescription: Absolute path to `hc` (herdr-core), used to read the live directory of the space's terminal. When empty it is searched like `appBin`; without it the space's registered folder is used.

herdrVscodeSync.pollSeconds.markdownDescription: How often to ask Herdr desktop which space is selected while this is the anchor window. `0` disables polling: the anchor then follows only on window focus and `current.json` changes.
